quote: a_t = 실제 오차 벡터 (q − h_true) 를 정규화 cavity SigL = (I/ν_E + G)^{-1} 의 고유기저에 사영한 분산의 상·하 사분위 평균 비(반복 ≥ 2 …)
title: a_t is not pinned, and its natural per-block reading makes H1 unfalsifiable again
consequence: a_t is stored per block (one error vector, N=32 projections) and H1/C-cavity use the block median. Read as 'quartiles of the 32 projected |v_i^H(q−h_true)|² sorted by value', an exactly isotropic CN(0, ν_q I) error gives (CPU sim, 20000 blocks) median a = 16.0, P(a ≤ 3) = 0.0000, 5–95% = 8.7–32.9 — so 'a_8 ≤ 3' can never hold, H1 (rejection = e_8 in band AND a_8 ≤ 3) is never rejected and C-cavity (= not-rejected) fires by construction: the round-1 #10/#11 defect (C-cavity true by construction) recurs in a new statistic. Read as 'the 8 eigen-directions of SigL with the largest eigenvalues vs the 8 smallest' (fixed by eigenvalue rank), the null is F(16,16): median 1.00, P(a ≤ 3) = 0.98, and the threshold is meaningful. The document does not say which, so the H1 verdict and the P2-B trigger are decided by the reader's choice. (e_t is fine: null median 0.99, P(in [0.7,1.4]) = 0.95.)
fix: Define per block a_t = mean_{i in top-8 eigenvalues of SigL} |v_i^H(q−h_true)|² / mean_{i in bottom-8 eigenvalues} |v_i^H(q−h_true)|² (directions fixed by eigenvalue rank, never by projected value), then median over blocks; note the isotropic null is F(16,16) (median 1, 97.5% ≈ 2.8) so 3 is a real band. If the value-sorted quartile ratio was intended, replace 3 by a null-calibrated threshold (e.g. > 33, the null 95% point) or drop the clause.

verdict.reason: Confirmed. The only definition of a_t is NEXT_EXPERIMENTS.md line 53: "(q − h_true) 를 정규화 cavity SigL = (I/ν_E + G)^{-1} 의 고유기저에 사영한 분산의 상·하 사분위 평균 비" — it names the basis but never says whether the "upper/lower quartile" is by eigenvalue rank of SigL or by the sorted projected values, and no other document or code pins it (grep of conf/, Demo/, REVIEW_AUDIT.md, CHANGELOG_REVIEW.md, 08_SPEC_analysis.md for 사분위/quartile/anisotrop finds no prior definition; diag_p1_cavity.py is unwritten, line 56). The statistic is per block (line 53 "저장(블록 × 반복)", line 37 "블록 중앙값"), so with N=32 each block has one error vector and 32 projections; the natural reading of the sentence ("quartiles of the projected variances") sorts by value. CPU simulation (isotropic CN(0,νI) error, 20000 blocks, any unitary basis): value-sorted reading gives median a = 15.85, P(a ≤ 3) = 0.0000, 5–95% = 8.6–32.9, and the n=640 block-median never leaves 14.9–16.7; eigenvalue-rank reading gives F(16,16)-like null: median 0.99, P(a ≤ 3) = 0.985, 97.5% = 2.71, block-median 0.94–1.05. e_t is fine either way (median 0.99, P(in [0.7,1.4]) = 0.95). Consequence: under the value-sorted reading "a_8 ≤ 3" is unattainable even when the cavity is perfectly isotropic, so H1 (line 37, rejection requires e_8 in band AND a_8 ≤ 3) can never be rejected, C-cavity (line 88, "a_8 중앙값 > 3") fires by construction and the P2-B design document is triggered unconditionally, and the §7 prediction "a_8 > 3 → 만족" (line 158) is a tautology — the exact round-1 #10/#22 defect (C-cavity true by construction) reappearing in the replacement statistic. Under the eigenvalue-rank reading the threshold is a real ~97.5% band. Line 96 admits "a ≤ 3 은 예비 자료 없이 정한 관용 폭" with no null calibration, so nothing elsewhere in v2 resolves which reading applies; the H1 verdict and the P2-B trigger are decided by the implementer's choice. Fix as proposed: define a_t with directions fixed by eigenvalue rank of SigL (top-8 vs bottom-8), then median over blocks, and note the F(16,16) null; or, if value-sorted was intended, replace 3 by a null-calibrated cut (≈33 at the 95% point) or drop the clause.

quote: 양측 부호검정 p < 0.05 그리고 |Δ| ≥ MDD(≈0.02) … (step 4) 2단계에서 C2 −3 dB 부호검정 p < 0.05 이고 Δ ≤ −MDD 일 때만
title: '|Δ| ≥ MDD(≈0.02)' has two readings that give opposite verdicts for net 11–12 blocks
consequence: Recomputed exact two-sided sign test at n=640: discordance 3/4/5/6/7/8% (n_d 19/26/32/38/45/51) gives MDD = 11/12/14/14/15/15 net blocks (0.017–0.023), so §0's '11~15' is correct. But if MDD is 'the smallest net count with p<0.05 at the observed n_d', the clause is redundant (p<0.05 already implies it); if it is the fixed 0.02 (= 12.8 → 13 blocks), it is stricter: for every n_d ≤ 30 the sign test reaches p<0.05 at net 11–12 (e.g. n_d=19 net 11 p=0.019; n_d=26 net 12 p=0.029). An H0 outcome of net 11–12 with p<0.05 is 'reject' under one reading and 'accept' under the other; the same ambiguity gates the one-shot test-set confirmation in step 4 ('Δ ≤ −MDD').
fix: Write one of: (a) 'MDD = smallest |a−b| with exact sign p<0.05 at the observed a+b (n_d 19→11, 26→12, 32–38→14, 45–51→15); the clause is therefore implied by p<0.05 and is reported, not tested', or (b) 'reject only if p<0.05 AND |a−b| ≥ 13 (0.02×640)'. Apply the same wording to step 4's trigger.

verdict.reason: Confirmed. (1) Numbers verified with the house sign_p (Demo/exp_0921_analysis.py:44, exact two-sided binomial) at n=640: smallest net |a−b| with p<0.05 is 11/10/12/12/14/14/15/15 at n_d=19/20/26/30/32/38/45/51 (p=0.019/0.041/0.029/0.043/0.020/0.034/0.036/0.049); so §0's '11~15 블록 = 0.017~0.023' is correct as a range and 0.02×640=12.8→13. Round-1's fix said '≥13 blocks'; v2 dropped that and wrote '≈0.02', so nothing elsewhere in v2 resolves it. (3) The ambiguity bites exactly where outcomes are expected: for n_d ≤ 30 the exact test first rejects at net 10–12, below 13 and at/below §0's own floor of 11 (n_d=20 rejects at net 10, p=0.041). Measured seed-to-seed V1 discordance at C2 −3 dB is 3.5–4.1% (n_d≈22–26 at n=640), and best-vs-last of the same run should be ≤ that. quote: 판정점 C2 −3/0/+3 dB, 양측 부호검정 + 3점 규칙(`10_SPEC` §3c), 나머지 SNR 은 보고 전용

verdict.reason: Confirmed. v2 §3.1 step 4 (NEXT_EXPERIMENTS.md:106) pre-registers the confirmatory test-set comparison as "양측 부호검정 + 3점 규칙(`10_SPEC` §3c)" and step 5 (:107) gates the headline replacement on "4 를 통과했을 때만", but neither v2 (§0:17 defines only the single-point test; §4 points back to §0), 10_SPEC §3c/§6 (:150, :256 just repeat the phrase), nor 08_SPEC §2 (:42, power guard only) states what the 3-point pass is. quote: attempt 는 데이터·잡음 스트림만 바꾼다. manifest 에 torch.initial_seed() 와 초기 가중치 해시를 적는다
title: Attempts (and aug vs ctrl) also differ in an unseeded random init; recording it does not pair them (round-1 #16 residual)
consequence: score.train seeds only the data generator g (score.py:882); make_model (score.py:541) builds the DiT from torch's global RNG and there is no manual_seed in train()/run_d2_sx.py, so every process starts from a fresh entropy init. Hence aug_i vs ctrl_i differ in init AND augmentation, and stage 2 / step 4 compare one aug model with one ctrl model. The registered success sentence '위상 augmentation 은 prior 자체의 개선이다' and §7 attribute a model-pair difference to the recipe; §2.5's reference '기존 last-EMA vs 재학습 last = GPU 비결정성' is mislabeled (it is dominated by the init draw). The promised manifest fields are also not implemented (run_manifest.py:71 records split/val/train/gate only) and are missing from the §6 선행 list, so the doc's own reproducibility requirement is unfollowable as of HEAD.
fix: For review_next runs add an opt-in init seed (torch.manual_seed(SEED_TRAIN + _rung_ix(rung)*17 + attempt) immediately before make_model, default off so existing recipes are untouched) so aug_i and ctrl_i share the init; list 'manifest: initial_seed + init-weights hash' under §6 선행; relabel the H0 reference as 'init + nondeterminism'; or restrict the success sentence to 'this checkpoint'.

verdict.reason: Code facts in the claim are correct (score.train seeds only g/gj at score.py:882-885; make_model at :541/:877 uses the unseeded global generator; no manual_seed in train()/run_d2_sx.py/train_nr16.py; the ckpt state at score.py:981-990 stores rng/rng_jac but no initial_seed or init hash; run_manifest.py records seeds=split/val/train/gate only; §6 선행 lists only --skip0/mean_arms/phase_aug). But the claimed consequence does not hold against v2 as written. (1) Not an unfixed round-1 residual: v2 line 22 discloses that make_model init comes from the global RNG per process and registers the user's recorded choice (CHANGELOG_REVIEW §5, 2026-09-23: '수정하지 않고 기록만 남긴다'); the claim's fix (seed init from attempt) reverses a registered user decision, which is a design preference, not a defect. (2) Already handled by v2's decision rule: the gate requires p < 0.05 AND |Δ| ≥ MDD, with MDD derived from the 3-8% discordance rate (line 17), i.e. calibrated to exactly the seed-level noise the claim worries about. Measured on the three existing same-recipe N=1e4 checkpoints (a1/a2/a3, which differ in init AND stream, an upper bound on init alone), V1@16 at C2 −3 dB: BLER 0.1453/0.1496/0.1477; paired net Δ = −1/−3/−2 blocks at n=640 (house sign p = 1.00/0.68/0.84) and −11/−6/+5 at n=2560 (p ≥ 0.29), discordance 3.6-4.1%. That is an order of magnitude under MDD (11-15 blocks at n=640), so a single aug-vs-ctrl pair cannot pass stage 3/4 by init luck; stage 1 additionally averages three independent inits per arm and reports '3 중 2'. One checkpoint per arm with separate seed-robustness reporting (10_SPEC §6g) is house practice, not a new unsoundness. (3) 'attempt 는 데이터·잡음 스트림만 바꾼다' is literally what the attempt integer does and sits in the same cell as the global-RNG disclosure, so no rule/code conflict. Residuals are real but not consequential for judging: the H0/§2.5 reference labelled 'GPU 비결정성' is in fact init draw + nondeterminism (a one-word relabel on a report-only value, no decision consumes it), and the initial_seed/init-hash recording needs a small train()-side change before §2.5/A1 runs launch (implementation hygiene of the same class as round-1 #17, judged not real). Worth a wording fix and a §6 line, not a defect that changes how results are judged.

quote: H4 판정 = 블록별 r_P(반복 ≥ 8 평균)를 반복 4 NMSE 와 함께 넣은 로지스틱 회귀의 우도비 검정
title: The C-pseudo likelihood-ratio test can reject for late-iteration trajectory, not for information in K; r_P median population unpinned
consequence: r_P = ‖νK‖_F/‖νJ‖_F is a function of the query (q_t, ν_t). Averaged over iterations 8–16 it encodes the block's late state (failing blocks sit at large ν_q / wrong q by iteration 8), while the only covariate is NMSE at iteration 4. So 'additional explanatory power' (p<0.05) is obtainable with K carrying nothing detection-useful — the same tautology the document removed from H1 by moving its regression to e_4 with NMSE@4 (§1 H1 '반복 4 의 NMSE 를 공변량으로 넣은 … e_4'). C-pseudo therefore does not test what §2.6 says it tests. Separately, H4's first clause 'r_P 중앙값 < 0.2' names no population (per-iteration medians of §2.4, all block×iteration samples, or the block-level iter≥8 mean), and §7's 'r_P 중앙값 ≈ 0.4' inherits the ambiguity.
fix: Use r_P at iteration 4 (same iteration as the covariate) as the tested predictor, or keep iter≥8 r_P but add NMSE and ν_q averaged over the same iterations as covariates. Define the median: 'median over blocks of the block-level r_P used in the regression'.

verdict.reason:
Confirmed as a design defect, with the mechanism verified numerically on the repo's own records and checkpoints (CPU only, scratchpad rp_traj_check.py / partA.py / partBC.py).

Document lines (conf/results/review_next/NEXT_EXPERIMENTS.md): §2.4 line 74 "H4 판정 = 블록별 r_P(반복 ≥ 8 평균)를 반복 4 NMSE 와 함께 넣은 로지스틱 회귀의 우도비 검정"; §1 H4 line 40 "r_P 중앙값 < 0.2 또는 블록별 r_P(반복 ≥ 8 평균)가 반복 4 NMSE 를 통제한 뒤 실패를 추가로 설명하지 못함(우도비 검정 p ≥ 0.05)"; §2.6 line 89 C-pseudo "(r_P 중앙값 ≥ 0.2 그리고 우도비 p < 0.05)" → P2-A design doc. v2 itself moved H1's regression to the same iteration as the covariate and made it report-only (line 37 "반복 4 의 NMSE 를 공변량으로 넣은 로지스틱 회귀에서 e_4 의 추가 설명력 … 보고 전용"), but H4 keeps a decision-bearing LRT whose predictor is an iteration ≥8 quantity and whose only covariate is iteration 4. No round-1 item and no other v2 section touches this rule (grep of prereg_review_raw.json / RECORD_CORRECTIONS_DRAFT.md for r_P: nothing).

Code fact: r_P is computed from the Jacobian of the denoiser at the receiver's query (q_t, ν_q,t) (score.py ScorePrior._eval: jacrev of tweedie_real at x=np_pack(q), sigma=NU_TO_SIGMA(nu); K=0.5[(A−D)+j(C+B)] per REVIEW_AUDIT P1-4a), and ν_q,t is set by the loop from the decoder posterior (t2_route_a.py:360-364), i.e. r_P(t) is a deterministic function of the block's state at iteration t.

Evidence (1) — late state predicts failure beyond NMSE@4: results/diag/ep-site-integration_D2_C2_snr-3_n128.npz (C2 −3 dB, RouteAClip scalar/belief/matrix wiring = the V1 wiring, ckpt d2sx_N10000_a1). Cell dscore|scorew (109/128 fail): σ_t median fail/ok = 0.498/0.260 at t=8, 0.400/0.260 at t=16; AUC(mean log σ_{t≥8} → fail)=0.951; LRT fail ~ logNMSE@4 + mean log σ_{t≥8}: LR=40.3, p=2.2e-10. Cell gmmB|scorew (38/128 fail, same wiring, GMM prior): AUC 0.949, LR=53.7, p=2.3e-13. A quadratic-in-NMSE@4 control adds nothing (p=0.36), so this is genuinely late-iteration information the covariate cannot absorb.

Evidence (2) — r_P is not a constant of the network: held-out AWGN queries, n=8/σ, d2sx_N160000_a1.pt: median r_P 0.323/0.444/0.485/0.453/0.480/0.463/0.477 at σ=0.033/0.092/0.182/0.256/0.360/0.507/0.845 (IQR at fixed σ up to 0.41–0.63, i.e. strong q-dependence too); d2sx_N10000_a1.pt: 0.186/0.296/0.416/0.424/0.461/0.438/0.481.

Evidence (3) — the document's exact test rejects with a K that carries no block information at all: substituting r̂_P(σ_t) from the held-out AWGN curve (a pure function of σ, no knowledge of the block) into the record's trajectories and running "블록별 r_P(반복 ≥ 8 평균) + NMSE@4" LRT gives p=1.05e-10 (N160000 curve, dscore|scorew), 8.2e-11 (N10000 curve), 1.0e-13 (gmmB|scorew), median block r_P 0.44–0.47 ≥ 0.2, i.e. C-pseudo "satisfied" and P2-A triggered by trajectory alone at n=128, let alone n=640. Note the claim's first fix (r_P at iteration 4) is also insufficient: the same proxy at t=4 still rejects (p≈3e-3–5e-3) because σ_4 already differs fail/ok (0.37 vs 0.26); only the second fix (add ν_q / NMSE averaged over the same iterations ≥8, or a matched-wiring control arm's r_P) makes the LRT speak to K.

Consequence for judging results: §7's pre-registered prediction "C-pseudo: … NMSE 통제 후 추가 설명력 없음 → 불만족" will be judged against a test that is expected to reject (p<0.05) even if K is detection-useless, so H4 will be recorded as "not rejected" and the P2-A design document will be triggered on a loop-trajectory artifact; conversely a non-rejection would not show K is useless. This is the same confound v2 explicitly removed from H1.

Secondary (real but less consequential): "r_P 중앙값" in H4/§2.6/§7 names no population (per-iteration medians of §2.4 "반복별", all block×iteration samples, or the block-level iter≥8 means). On on-distribution queries all three are ≈0.45–0.48 for the headline checkpoint, so the 0.2 clause is unlikely to be straddled, but on real queries this is unmeasured and the rule should say "median over blocks of the block-level r_P used in the regression".

quote: 둘 다 같은 방향·비슷한 크기면 "adapter 일반 효과(prior 무관)", V1 에서만 개선이면 "prior 에 특이적"
title: '비슷한 크기' is undefined, so the attribution verdict is a free choice (round-1 #20 residual)
consequence: The symmetric control now exists, but the rule that reads it has no comparator: with e.g. V1-mean −15 net blocks (p<0.05) and gmmB-scorew-mean −7 (p≈0.1), both 'adapter 일반 효과' and 'prior 에 특이적' are defensible readings, and the recorded sentence goes into the write-up either way. verdict.reason: Confirmed residual of round-1 #20. NEXT_EXPERIMENTS.md line 118 (§3.2) still reads "둘 다 같은 방향·비슷한 크기면 'adapter 일반 효과(prior 무관)', V1 에서만 개선이면 'prior 에 특이적'" with no numeric or statistical definition of "비슷한 크기" or of "개선" for the gmmB arm; round-1 #20 (prereg_review_raw.json idx 20) explicitly flagged "'같은 크기' undefined", and v2 only renamed it and added the symmetric control. Nothing else in v2 supplies the comparator: line 93 "임계값 근거" lists provenance for every other threshold (0.10, 0.2, LR 0.05, [0.7,1.4], [0.8,1.25], a≤3) and omits this one; §0's MDD (11–15 net blocks) is for a single paired difference, not a difference-of-differences, and §3.2 does not invoke it. The proposed fix (exact sign test on per-trial interaction d, or a fixed ratio band with both p<0.05) is consistent with the §0 house test and closes it in one line.

quote: 세 구간의 격자점 2/3 이상에서 성립 → 기각
title: '2/3 of the grid points of the three tiers' is pooled-or-per-tier ambiguous; only the pooled reading makes C-calib its complement
consequence: Pooled over 20 points: H2 rejected iff ≥ 14 points satisfy both bands; C-calib ('1/3 이상 … ∉') fires iff ≥ 7 points fail — exact complements. Per tier: 하 needs ≥ 5/7, 중 ≥ 6/8, 상 ≥ 4/5 — a run with 14 good points but only 3/5 in 상 rejects H2 under one reading and not the other, and C-calib (which has no per-tier wording) then disagrees with H2.

quote: **a_t** = 실제 오차 벡터 (q − h_true) 를 **정규화 cavity SigL = (I/ν_E + G)^{-1} 의 고유기저**에 사영한 분산의 상·하 사분위 평균 비 … **V1, C2 −3 dB, 반복 8, 블록 중앙값**: e_8 ∈ [0.7, 1.4] **그리고** a_8 ≤ 3 → 기각
title: Per-block a_t is ~16 under a perfectly isotropic error, so a_8 <= 3 is impossible: H1 unrejectable, C-cavity fires by construction
consequence: §2.1 stores a_t per (block x iteration) and H1/C-cavity use the block median. For ONE error vector in C^32 the 32 projected |c_i|^2 are ~Exp order statistics regardless of the basis, and the top-quartile/bottom-quartile mean ratio is ~16 (CPU simulation, e ~ CN(0, nu I), random SigL, 640 blocks: median 16.1, IQR [12.4, 20.8], P(a<=3)=0.000; whitened by SigL eigenvalues: 72). So a_8 <= 3 never holds even when the cavity assumption is exactly true, H1 (an AND) can never be rejected, C-cavity ('H1 not rejected') triggers the P2-B design step unconditionally, and §7's prediction 'a_8 > 3 -> 만족(비등방 쪽)' is a tautology -- the same class of defect round 1 flagged for cond(G) and the AUC clause. If instead 'variance' means pooling across blocks (ratio 1.11 in the same simulation), then '저장(블록 x 반복)' and '블록 중앙값' are contradictory and the rule cannot be applied as written.
fix: Define a_t pooled: for each block project the error onto SigL's eigenbasis sorted by eigenvalue, average |c_i|^2/nu_q over the 640 blocks per sorted index (or per eigenvalue quantile bin), then take the top/bottom-quartile ratio -- one number per (arm, point, iteration). Calibrate the threshold on the isotropic null inside the script (draw e ~ CN(0, nu_q I) on the same SigL's; null ratio ~1.1 at n=640) and set the anisotropy criterion relative to it (e.g. a_8 >= 2 x null). Keep e_t per block (its per-block median IS well-behaved).

verdict.reason: Confirmed. §2.1 line 53 defines a_t per (block × iteration) as "실제 오차 벡터 (q − h_true) 를 … SigL 의 고유기저에 사영한 분산의 상·하 사분위 평균 비", and H1 (line 37) / C-cavity (line 88) / §7 (line 158) all judge on "a_8 블록 중앙값 ≤ 3". Code facts: for C2 (8×4) N = 32, and Demo/t2_route_a.py:run produces exactly one q per block per iteration, so the per-direction "variance" is a single |c_i|^2 — 32 Exp-distributed numbers. Under the literal reading (quartiles OF the projected variances), the top/bottom-quartile ratio is a basis-free Exp(1) order-statistic ratio: CPU simulation with e ~ CN(0, νI) exactly isotropic and random SigL over 640 blocks gives median 16.05, IQR [11.98, 21.38], minimum 6.41, P(a ≤ 3) = 0 (Exp(1) n=32 analytic median 15.92; whitening by SigL eigenvalues makes it 20.6, not better). So a_8 ≤ 3 can never hold, H1 (an AND) is unrejectable, C-cavity (an OR on a_8 > 3) fires unconditionally, and §7's "a_8 > 3 → 만족(비등방 쪽)" is a guaranteed prediction — the same true-by-construction class round 1 flagged for this very condition ("C-cavity's second clause is true by construction" / "The C5 clause of C-cavity is satisfied by construction"); v2 swapped the clause but reintroduced the defect. Adversarial check: the one charitable reading — quartiles taken along the SigL EIGENVALUE ordering (top-8 vs bottom-8 eigen-directions) — is well-behaved (same null: median 0.98, IQR [0.67, 1.36], P(a ≤ 3) = 0.98), but v2 nowhere states the sort key (no "고유값 순", pooling, or null-calibration wording anywhere in the file). Two readings of the written rule yield 16 vs 1 on identical data and flip the H1/C-cavity/P2-B verdict, so the rule as written is either a tautology or unapplicable — consequential for judging results. Fix is one sentence: sort directions by SigL eigenvalue (or pool |c_i|^2/ν_q per sorted index across the 640 blocks) and state the isotropic-null reference for the threshold.

quote: **헤드라인 교체는 4 를 통과했을 때만**, 그리고 "게이트 통과 = D1 형제(aug)" 로 표기해서. 4 가 실패하면 A1 은 "개발 집합에서만 개선" 으로 기록된다.
title: Headline replacement is decided by the test-set sign test, i.e. the headline arm is chosen by BLER; a gate-passing aug arm is not reported on the test set unless dev wins
consequence: Steps 4-5 make (a) whether the aug arm is evaluated on the test set at all conditional on the dev BLER, and (b) whether it becomes the headline conditional on the test-set BLER outcome. 10_SPEC §3b: '변형 간 선택을 BLER 로 하지 않는다. arm 으로 승격할 변형은 D1 게이트 통과 여부로만 정한다. 둘 이상이 통과하면 둘 다 arm 으로 올리고 둘 다 보고한다'; 01_RULES §5: '이번 실행의 BLER을 보고 arm·파라미터·격자를 고르지 않는다'. Under those rules a D1-gate-PASS aug recipe is an arm and must appear beside ctrl-V1 in the reported table regardless of the dev result; making its test-set appearance and 'headline' status depend on winning is exactly the selection the rules exclude, and a reviewer can reject the promoted headline with the pre-registration giving no answer.
fix: Rewrite steps 4-5: if the D1 sibling passes GA-GD, aug-V1(best) and ctrl-V1(best) are BOTH reported in one new test-set table (same trials, same tag) irrespective of the dev outcome; the dev test only decides whether the test-set comparison is powered enough to be worth running now or is deferred, never whether the arm exists. Fix the headline rule before any BLER is seen (e.g. 'the headline stays tables_D2_B16e4k; the aug/ctrl table is a separate registered table' or 'headline = the gate-passing recipe registered here, win or lose'), and state that a losing test result is reported in the same table.

verdict.reason: Not a defect; v2 already handles the selection concern and the claim's premise misreads the rule. (1) Arm status is not decided by BLER in v2: §3.1 line 102-103 fixes "승격 기준은 BLER 이 아니라 D1 게이트다" and step 1 makes the D1 sibling's GA~GD the only promotion gate (FAIL → stop without looking at BLER; step 3 proceeds "2 의 결과와 무관하게" on gate PASS). That is exactly 10_SPEC §3b / 04_SPEC §6 / 01_RULES §5, and it is the fix the round-1 rules finding demanded. (2) Nothing is hidden and nothing is chosen by BLER: every stage is reported win or lose (step 2 "전부 보고 전용", step 3 "2 의 결과를 함께 보고", step 5 "4 가 실패하면 … '개발 집합에서만 개선' 으로 기록"), and whenever the test-set run happens both aug-V1 and ctrl-V1 are in it (step 4 "1차 비교 = aug-V1(best) vs ctrl-V1(best) … 새 태그"). A gate-PASS/dev-FAIL aug is still an arm with its verdict in the dev table; the rule's "둘 다 보고한다" is satisfied, and no claim about it is made on the test set, so a reviewer has nothing to reject. (3) The dev gate (§0 "확증 실행 … §3.1 2단계 통과 시 한 번", step 4 "p < 0.05 이고 Δ ≤ −MDD 일 때만") decides only whether the test-set stage runs, on separate pre-registered data (skip 2560-3199); this is the structure the accepted round-1 leakage fix prescribed, and as a sequential screen it is conservative (dev MDD ≈0.02 > test MDD ≈0.01 → loses power, does not inflate claims). (4) "Headline replaced only if the pre-named confirmatory test passes" is a claim rule, not an arm-selection rule; confirm-then-claim is house style (10_SPEC §3c, 08_SPEC §2), and the demanded "headline = gate-passing recipe, win or lose" appears in no rule and contradicts house precedent (headline moved V0→V1 by recorded DECISIONS 2026-09-22 01:00 after all gate-passing variants sat in one table). Consequence claimed ("pre-registration gives no answer") is false: arm by gate, claim by the pre-named test at fixed 판정점, both arms in the same table. verdict.reason: Confirmed against code. Demo/t2_gmm.py:120 (RouteAClip._matrix_site): `self.shift += float(np.sum(np.abs(mu - hH) ** 2) / max(np.sum(np.abs(hH) ** 2), 1e-300))` — the SQUARED relative norm, summed over clipped calls only (t2_gmm.py:58 docstring says the same: "shift = sum over clipped calls of |mu_legacy - m|^2 / |m|^2"). conf/code/runner.py:417 stores `so.shift / max(so.n_clip, 1)` per trial, i.e. the mean of squared relative shifts per clipped call; runner.py:32 labels it "mean relative shift". Fix: either state that the recorded value is the mean over clipped calls of |μ_legacy − h_H|²/|h_H|² (and that for clip='mean' it is the counterfactual), or store sqrt of the per-call delta.
